annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/654 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 with regard to technical and general requirements relating to emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/654 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 with regard to technical and general requirements relating to emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 102
annotation.summary_en: EU delegated regulation setting technical requirements, test methods, conformity-of-production arrangements and technical-service standards for emission limits and type-approval of internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery. It concerns pollutant emissions, not AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets test procedures and apparatus for measuring gaseous and particulate emissions of NRMM engines
Prohibits defeat-device-like emission control strategies and regulates auxiliary strategies
Establishes deterioration factors and emission durability periods
Sets performance standards for technical services
